resources.string: This build processes video and audio for scripts. The timeline editor and the Studio recorder come in later builds.
All files access is not granted. Processing tasks report STORAGE_PERMISSION_DENIED until you grant it.
All files access is granted. Scripts and the Studio screens can read and write the paths you choose.
Video and audio processing, multi-track timeline editing, transitions and subtitles, with script code generated from the app screens
A script asked to read or write a path outside the plugin folders. Grant all files access, then run the script again.
